Specifications

BLOCK - 1

FOUNDATION

R.C.C. pile foundation

STRUCTURE

R.C.C. framed structure

WALLS

Made of first quality concrete hollow blocks

WALL FINISH

Weather / Cement paint coat for external walls. Putty finish and distemper finish for internal walls.

DOORS

Elegantly designed front door. All other doors are made of good quality hard wood frames with paneled shutters.

WINDOWS

Aluminium framed windows with steel grill and glass panes.

TOILETS

Ceramic tiles for floor. Ceramic tile dadoing up to a height of 6 feet. Concealed plumbing. Coloured sanitary fixtures and C.P. fittings. Provision for geyser in master bed toilet.

KITCHEN

Ergonomically designed kitchen with granite worktop and stainless steel sink

FLOORING

Entrance lobby- good quality granite/vitrified tiles. Upper floor lobbies- granite or vitrified tiles. Interior- Good quality ceramic tiles.

ELECTRICAL WORK

Concealed conduit copper wiring with independent energy meter. Light and Fan points and other necessary plug points with standard switches, switch board & A/c provision in master bedroom

WATER SUPPLY

Drinking water from KWA line in kitchen. Water drawn from well for other purposes. Round the clock water supply through sump and overhead tank.

FIRE SAFETY

Ensured with modern Fire fighting equipments.

CAR PARK

Ensured with modern Fire fighting equipments.

LIFT

Lifts with 8 passenger capacity.

GENERATOR

For common area lighting, lifts and selected points in apartments.

INTERCOM

To flats in luxury block and security cabin.

All bedrooms are attached with bathrooms
